answer: Normalized compression distance screening: each epoch the node compresses every pair of answers, NCD(x,y) = (C(xy) - min(C(x),C(y))) / max(C(x),C(y)). Clones driven by one controller share phrasing and structure, so their pairs sit near the nadir of the distribution. Any reef of answers whose pairwise NCD falls a fixed delta below the epoch median shares a single reward slot, while honest independent writers keep full credit and paraphrasing costs real work.
